items.q: What is DMCC Free Zone and why is it ideal for business setup in Dubai?
items.a: DMCC is considered the #1 free zone in the world, located in JLT Dubai. It has a vibrant community across commodities, crypto, consulting, trading, and professional services with simple registration, excellent legal frameworks, and world-class infrastructure.

items.q: What types of licenses are available in DMCC Free Zone?
items.a: Trading License (buying/selling goods), Service License (legal, consulting, IT), Industrial License (light manufacturing), E-commerce License (online retail), and Freelance Permit (individual contractors).

items.q: How long does it take to register a company in DMCC Free Zone?
items.a: DMCC registration typically takes 5-7 business days for a standard application.

items.q: Can I get 100% foreign ownership for my DMCC company?
items.a: Yes. DMCC allows 100% foreign ownership — no local sponsor required.

items.q: Which industries are best suited for DMCC Free Zone?
items.a: Commodities (gold, diamond, tea, coffee), crypto and Web3, tech and AI, financial services, media, consulting, and e-commerce.

items.q: Can I open a bank account after getting a DMCC license?
items.a: Yes. DMCC has strong banking relationships which make corporate account opening easier for member companies.

items.q: Is DMCC Free Zone suitable for freelancers and small startups?
items.a: Yes. DMCC offers freelance permits and cost-effective packages including flexi-desks designed for individuals and small businesses.

items.q: What are the office options available in DMCC Free Zone?
items.a: Flexi Desks, Executive Offices, Private Offices, and Virtual Offices — all in the vibrant JLT area of Dubai.

items.q: What is the minimum cost to set up in DMCC?
items.a: DMCC company setup starts from AED 33,000 per year including membership, license, and flexi-desk. Full trading company with one visa: roughly AED 30,000 - 45,000.

items.q: Can I get a visa with a DMCC license?
items.a: Yes. DMCC allows visa quotas based on office space. A flexi-desk gives you 1 visa, while dedicated offices allow more (up to 6).
